KeyShot

KeyShot

KeyShot focuses on physically based product rendering, materials and animation.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Import a product assembly

Use the selected model, asset hierarchy and scale. In the intended KeyShot preview, import a product assembly; the visible result is a composed scene with geometry and camera framing visible. Review object identity, silhouette and missing assets before accepting or exporting it.

Build a material study

Start from the approved scene state, materials and motion intent. In the intended KeyShot preview, build a material study; the visible result is a lighting, animation or effects preview with changed controls exposed. Review timing, material response, collisions and visual continuity before accepting or exporting it.

Render an exploded animation

Begin with the reviewed cameras, render settings and delivery format. In the intended KeyShot preview, render an exploded animation; the visible result is a bounded presentation sequence or image comparison. Review frame content, colour, legibility and output specification before accepting or exporting it.
